note: keys = stored columns / API payload fields of the Terminal v2 tables and routes, or panel ids (`panels`, page.panel); every value is one line of at most 200 characters

tooltips.actual_points: The index's own move over the horizon from NSE's daily file.
tooltips.ann_vol: FOVOLT annualised volatility (× √365) for the underlying.
tooltips.atm_iv: IV interpolated at the forward for this expiry. arithmetic.
tooltips.ban: In the F&O ban list for the next session (named for the next trading day).
tooltips.call_oi: Call open interest on the expiry, contracts.
tooltips.change_date: When the current leader took over under the hysteresis rule.
tooltips.changed_from: The previous leader before the last regime change.
tooltips.crush_pct: iv_post_1d ÷ iv_pre_1d − 1: the IV crush. Describes past releases, does not forecast the next.
tooltips.data.chip: Header chip 'DATA n STALE' counting red rows; links to SYS › DATA.
tooltips.data.table: Every catalogued dataset: stored date, expected by, sessions behind, catch-up slot, state fresh/amber/red/gap. No composite score.
tooltips.delta: Black-76 delta (discounted) at the strike's own IV; the NSE delta factor sits beside it.
tooltips.delta_factor: NSE Clearing's delta per contract (Contract_Delta file, ≈ 18:30–19:20 IST). Cross-check of ours. context.
tooltips.des.iv_strip: Profile IV strip: iv30_cm, rank, percentile, skew, IV − RV, next results. Bloomberg DES. context.
tooltips.desk.book_vs_nifty: The Desk's real lots × stored closes in pp of NAV beside NIFTY's leaderboard; 'in the liquid fund since 30 Oct' while in cash.
tooltips.dte: Calendar days to this expiry at the 15:30 close.
tooltips.effective_n: 1 ÷ Σ weight²: how many names the index effectively is.
tooltips.error_factor_measured: The heuristic's measured error: 4.8× over Breeze SPAN on the NIFTY 09-Nov-2026 iron condor.
tooltips.evts.crush: Per-stock results IV-crush ledger: last 8 releases, IV before/after, crush %, implied vs realised. ORATS earnings. context.
tooltips.ew_minus_cw_pp: Equal-weight minus cap-weight return over 20 sessions, pp; negative = narrow. context.
tooltips.ew_pct: Equal-weight return of the members over the window.
tooltips.ewma_daily_vol: NSE's EWMA daily volatility (λ 0.995) from the FOVOLT file.
tooltips.expected_by: IST time the dataset should be stored by (trading-day aware). Past it: amber; past the lag budget: red.
tooltips.expected_move_1d_pct: One-day 1σ move implied by iv30_cm ÷ √252. arithmetic.
tooltips.expected_move_pct: 1σ move to expiry: ATM IV × √T. arithmetic.
tooltips.explained_points: Σ member points over the horizon.
tooltips.forward: Forward price for the expiry, from put-call parity at the strike nearest spot where both sides traded.
tooltips.fovolt_ann: NSE Clearing's EWMA vol (λ 0.995) annualised × √365: the margin vol. context.
tooltips.fut_vol: FOVOLT annualised volatility of the current-month future.
tooltips.hhi_contrib: Herfindahl index of contribution shares (1 = one name did it all).
tooltips.implied_method: How the implied event move was derived (term-structure split or the straddle).
tooltips.implied_move_pct: The move the options priced before the release (term-structure split of the event σ).
tooltips.index_close_source: nse_daily_file: the index level is NSE's ind_close_all, never Yahoo.
tooltips.iv: Black-76 IV on the parity forward for this strike; blank when the strike did not trade.
tooltips.iv30_cm: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV, interpolated in variance between the bracketing expiries (VIX method). arithmetic.
tooltips.iv_10d_call: IV at the +0.10-delta strike (the far call wing).
tooltips.iv_10d_put: IV at the −0.10-delta strike (the far put wing).
tooltips.iv_25d_call: IV at the strike whose own Black-76 delta is +0.25.
tooltips.iv_25d_put: IV at the strike whose own Black-76 delta is −0.25.
tooltips.iv_minus_rv20: iv30_cm − rv20_cc: the volatility risk premium. context, never coloured.
tooltips.iv_pctile_252: IV percentile: share of the last 252 sessions with iv30_cm below today. Not the rank.
tooltips.iv_post_1d: Near-expiry ATM IV the session after the release.
tooltips.iv_pre_1d: Near-expiry ATM IV the session before the release.
tooltips.iv_pre_5d: Near-expiry ATM IV five sessions before the results release.
tooltips.iv_rank_252: IV rank: (today − 252-session min) ÷ (max − min) × 100 on iv30_cm. Not the percentile.
tooltips.iwf_correction: official top-10 weight ÷ rebuilt weight on the calibration day; the other 40 names pro rata.
tooltips.lag_sessions: Trading sessions between the last stored row and the last completed session.
tooltips.last_modified: The publisher's Last-Modified header (GMT; IST = +5:30), the clock evidence for the schedule.
tooltips.leader: Largest |points| over the window, held with hysteresis (≥ 1.3× / 1.2× for 5 sessions). context, no colour.
tooltips.leader_share: Leader's |points| as a share of all members' |points| over the window.
tooltips.limit_next_day: Next session's position limit per the combineoi zip.
tooltips.log_moneyness: ln(K ÷ F): the x-axis of the smile, comparable across days.
tooltips.max_age_sessions: Lag budget before the row turns red (sessions for daily data, days otherwise).
tooltips.memb.concentration: Top-5 share, contribution and weight HHI, effective N, EW − CW over time.
tooltips.memb.fit: The identity's fit: explained vs actual points, MAE and R² over 60 sessions, today's residual, which weights priced the day.
tooltips.memb.monthly: 12-month leaderboard: leader, top-3 add and drag per month. context.
tooltips.memb.regime: Driver regime strip: leader with tenure and share, 60-session leader, top-5 share, EW − CW, in the neutral token; describes, does not predict.
tooltips.memb.sectors: Σ points by NSE industry over the horizon. Bloomberg IMAP.
tooltips.memb.table: Members over the chosen horizon: weight, return, points, share; the PTS column follows the horizon. Bloomberg MEMB.
tooltips.members_down: Members with a negative return over the window.
tooltips.members_up: Members with a positive return over the window.
tooltips.method: official_top10 (NSE file) · rebuilt (filings) · rebuilt_calibrated (scaled to the file).
tooltips.mid: Bid/ask midpoint the intraday IV is computed from, never the last trade.
tooltips.model_version: The IV convention (b76-pcp-v1: Black-76 on the parity forward, T = days ÷ 365). A new convention = new rows.
tooltips.monthly_atm_iv: ATM IV of the first expiry 20–60 days out.
tooltips.monthly_expiry: The expiry the monthly ATM IV is read from.
tooltips.mov.today: Who moved the index today, live from the heatmap (the only live panel; history on MEMB).
tooltips.mwpl: Market-wide position limit for the stock (combineoi zip).
tooltips.mwpl_pct: Open interest as % of the market-wide position limit; ≥ 95 % = F&O ban next session. context.
tooltips.n_iv_strikes: Strikes with a computable IV (traded; OTM wings plus 3 % ITM). Stocks: near/next month only.
tooltips.near_atm_iv: ATM IV of the first expiry with more than 2 days left; saw-tooths with the weekly calendar, hence the CM series.
tooltips.near_dte: Calendar days to the near expiry at the 15:30 close.
tooltips.near_expiry: The expiry the near ATM IV is read from (dte > 2).
tooltips.next_results: Next results date from nse_events, for the screener's results_within filter.
tooltips.non_span_margin_required: Exposure margin added on top of SPAN, a flat % of notional with no spread offset.
tooltips.notional_oi: Notional open interest from the combineoi_deleq file.
tooltips.nse_iv: NSE's own option-chain-v3 IV stored beside ours in the same snapshot (two models, labelled; O-T7).
tooltips.omon.chain: Greeks per strike from Black-76; NSE delta beside ours; MWPL % for stocks. Bloomberg OMON.
tooltips.omon.history: iv30_cm with the monthly line and India VIX overlay; results/budget/expiry markers; rank and percentile chips, each defined. Bloomberg HIVG.
tooltips.omon.live: Today's 15-minute IV path from Breeze chain snapshots; SourceChip LIVE Breeze / LIVE NSE / OFFLINE. context.
tooltips.omon.term: Near/next/far ATM IV + 30/60/90 CM, 25Δ skew with its 1-y percentile, straddle vs history, IV vs RV (cc/Parkinson/YZ/FOVOLT). Bloomberg OVDV.
tooltips.ostr.margin: Real margin for the structure: SPAN + exposure from Breeze, else the NSE SPAN file, else the heuristic with its 4.8× error printed.
tooltips.pcr: put_oi ÷ call_oi. context; never coloured green or red.
tooltips.points: Previous index level × weight × return: this member's share of the index move, in points. arithmetic.
tooltips.prev_index_level: L_{d−1}, the level the points are measured from.
tooltips.price_source: cls (ClsPric with volume > 0) or none: untraded strikes carry NSE's theoretical settle and get no IV.
tooltips.put_oi: Put open interest on the expiry, contracts.
tooltips.quality_flags: Stored data-quality flags: untraded strikes, forward fallback, thin expiry, grid change.
tooltips.r: Risk-free rate used, dated constant 6.5 % (O-T5), recorded on every row.
tooltips.raw_leader: Today's largest |points| name before hysteresis: the one that flips every two sessions.
tooltips.realised_move_pct: |move| at the next open/close after the release.
tooltips.residual_points: Index move − Σ member points: what the identity does not explain. Shown, never hidden.
tooltips.ret_pct: The member's adjusted return over the horizon.
tooltips.revision: 0 for the first fetch; +1 each time a re-fetch changed the body (sha256).
tooltips.rv20_parkinson: Realised vol from the daily high–low range (Parkinson), 20 sessions × √252.
tooltips.rv20_yz: Realised vol from open/high/low/close incl. overnight gaps (Yang-Zhang), 20 sessions × √252.
tooltips.sha256: Hash of the fetched body: the dedupe key for revisions.
tooltips.skew_25d: iv_25d_put − iv_25d_call for this expiry. context, uncoloured.
tooltips.skew_25d_30: 25Δ put IV − 25Δ call IV interpolated to 30 days; positive = puts dearer. context, uncoloured.
tooltips.source_chip: Where the margin came from: BREEZE (live session) → NSE SPAN FILE (offline) → HEURISTIC (last resort).
tooltips.span_margin_required: SPAN initial margin for the whole structure (offsets included). arithmetic; source chip BREEZE / NSE SPAN FILE / HEURISTIC.
tooltips.spot: Underlying close used; spot_source says whether it came from the F&O file or the daily index file.
tooltips.spot_source: Where the spot came from: the UDiFF UndrlygPric column or the ind_close_all file (legacy era).
tooltips.tenure_sessions: Sessions the current leader has held the regime.
tooltips.term_slope_30_90: iv90_cm − iv30_cm; positive = far months dearer. context.
tooltips.top5_share: Share of |points| from the five largest contributors over the window.
tooltips.unrecoverable: A missed capture cannot be backfilled (session-bound): a gap row is written instead.
tooltips.vega: Price change per 1 vol-point of IV, per unit.
tooltips.vol.cone: Min / 25 / 50 / 75 / max of constant-maturity IV by tenor over 1/3/5 years, with today's term. Bloomberg GV cone.
tooltips.vol.iv_vs_rv: IV paid vs vol delivered over the last 12 monthly expiries, and the expected-move hit-rate over 60 sessions. context.
tooltips.vol.screener: All 224 underlyings: iv30_cm, rank, percentile, rv20_yz, spread, term slope, skew, next results, ban, MWPL %. Sort, filter, export.
tooltips.vol.skew: 25Δ / 10Δ skew history and the smile today vs one month ago. Bloomberg SKEW. context.
tooltips.vol.term: Term structure today and the 30→90 slope history. Bloomberg VCA. context.
tooltips.weight_method: Which weight set priced the day: rebuilt_calibrated when the top-10 file existed, else rebuilt.
tooltips.weight_pct: Point-in-time index weight (rebuilt from filings, calibrated to NSE's top-10 file). arithmetic.
